items.title: Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2022
items.q: So we’re finally into the fifth attempt at doing this whole side. And at that point when it comes to Larry’s guitar solo

ctx.x: And so if you made a mistake it’s like ugh, you’ve got to go back and the guy’s got to heat up the vinyl you know. That process was terrible.

There’s a funny story that goes with that which is, and they’re actually really good records, but Darius had written a song called “The Midnight Sailor.” And that was the one that was the worst. Where it was never our fault, it was like one time a cop car went down the alley between the two. And like in the take it was like [speaks loudly as if with megaphone] “we’ve got a ten four five…” you know it was like oh, no. And it was 18 minutes into a beautiful performance of three tunes on one side. So that got…

I’m glad you mentioned Darius because there’s this wonderful picture in the recent book about your father, A Life in Time and you three are standing behind your parents and it struck me, it looks, it’s the time of the era. It looks like Dave and Iola go to Haight Asbury. Because you all had really long hair and it just is so terrific to see that combination of the generations. And I’m not even sure what I’m trying to say except it’s a great pic.
